content: Custom attributes extend Contact/Conversation/Company with typed fields (text, number, currency, list, date, checkbox, link). Canned responses = account-wide reusable reply snippets; Macros = one-click multi-step action bundles. Automation rules: triggers (conversation created/updated/opened, new message) x conditions (label, priority, inbox, language, country, custom attr) x actions (assign agent/team, label, reply, resolve, snooze, email team) — automation rules are Business/Enterprise-gated per one source but core CRUD automation is generally available in Community; verify current tier gating at setup time. Reports (conversation volume, first response time, CSAT) and CSAT surveys are Community edition.
